task: G19 primary source verification and correction

primary_locators: Nesterenko 2020 PLB 808, 135642 p. 3 left col & refs 45,47
item1_interactions_na14_vs_jj45pna.summary: NA-14 uses CD-Bonn with Vlow-k and empirical multipole corrections in OXBASH; jj45pna uses CD-Bonn with perturbative G-matrix in NuShellX without local multipole tuning. Authors never treat them as the same interaction.

primary_locators: Dunlop 2016 PRC 93, 062801(R) p. 1-2, p. 4 right col, refs 9,10,12
item2_dunlop_quenching_scope.summary: Scaling q from 0.66 to 0.75 was performed in large-scale shell-model calculations for N=82 waiting points (Zhi 2013, Lorusso 2015); it cannot be generalized to DF3+CQRPA or RHB+RQRPA global EDF/QRPA models.

primary_locators: Saito 2020 PRC 102, 024337 p. 2 right col, p. 6 right col, refs 14,15
item3_saito_table2_halflives_origin.summary: Saito 2020 Table II half-lives 147(3) ms and 157(8) ms are adopted directly from Dunlop 2016 Table I from the same GRIFFIN dataset; they are independent of Taprogge 2015 EURICA data.

primary_locators: Saito 2020 PRC 102, 024337 p. 2 left col ref 12, p. 6 right col ref 32
item4_mass_evaluation_vintage_and_q_cova.summary: 129Cd Ex=343(8) keV is from Manea 2020 PRL whereas Qbeta=9780(17) keV is from AME2016; without published experimental covariance, propagating error to 10123(19) keV in quadrature is unsupported.

item5_pn_and_valence_gt_percentages.summary: Pn 10-15% and valence GT 2-5 losing 95% of Ikeda strength are not reported in the primary sources; G19 extrapolated them without authorization.

primary_locators: TAGS unfolding principles, response matrix dependencies, delayed neutron backgrounds
item6_tags_unbiased_claim.summary: TAGS relies on level density / gamma strength unfolding and cannot cleanly separate near-equal half-life isomers (147 vs 157 ms) without pre-trap isomeric separation; claiming it is completely unbiased or fundamentally eliminates all Pandemonium is exaggerated.

primary_locators: Saito 2020 PRC 102, 024337 p. 6, p. 10 left col, Fig 8
item7_ff_operator_treatment.summary: NA-14 only calculated allowed GT transitions; FF transitions were not calculated via a microscopic weak operator, but were inferred from empirical logft ranges and parity selection rules.

item8_table_129cd_feeding_csv_integrity.summary: G19 CSV contained severe column misplacements (e.g. 1761 keV put 45(10)%, 1354 keV put 5.7(2)%), column swaps (2015 and 2058 keV), omitted the second (3347) keV level, and fabricated upper limits into blank cells. All 40 levels have been reconstructed exactly from Table II.

residual_issues_for_parent: AME2020 covariance between 129Cd ground state and isomer is not in journal text; precision Q-window calculations require direct AME covariance matrix or PI-ICR frequency ratios.
Clarify 3150 keV normalization: 24.1(9)% is total 129Cd decays, 45(10)% is relative to 11/2- parent decays alone.
Operator limitations (absence of microscopic relativistic First-Forbidden treatment) strictly restricted to the papers read here, not extrapolated to global theory.
Single-level discrepancy of 130In(10-) by ~200 keV in jj45pna reflects local multipole/truncation limitations, not global falsification of the interaction.
